passage:
A photographer posted her pictures online with a small watermark. A company copied one photo and removed the mark.
When she contacted them, the company apologized and paid her. In class, students discussed why creative work needs protection.
Some students thought copying online pictures was harmless because they were easy to download. The teacher explained that easy access does not mean free ownership.
The class learned about credit, permission, and fair use.
The watermark was small, but the issue was large. Behind every image, song, or article is someone's time and skill. Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A photographer posted her pictures online with a small watermark.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Watermark: A photographer posted her pictures online with a small watermark.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Digital Divide」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Online Museum Theft」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Dog at the Gate」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
